title: Space Mouse
tagline: One small mouse, one abandoned space station, and somewhere aboard: cheese
description: A platformer in the dark. Run, jump and wall-jump through an empty station by the light of your helmet lamp and its dying tubes, eat your way through cheese, stomp the old cat-bots that still patrol the decks, and don't touch the live cables. Find the great cheese at the end of every sector.
controls: jump (hold to go higher; jump again sliding down a wall)
drop through a catwalk; eat the cheese you stand on

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.help: The station's artificial gravity, for the mouse and everything that falls. Jumps keep their height, so lower gravity makes them slower and floatier.

jumpHeight.label: Jump height
jumpHeight.help: How high a full jump (button held) goes. A tap gives about half.

airControl.label: Air control
airControl.help: How much you can steer in the air, against how quickly you change direction on the ground.

wallJump.label: Wall jumps
wallJump.help: Slide down walls and jump off them.

catSpeed.label: Cat-bot speed
catSpeed.help: How fast the cat-bots patrol and chase (0 = switched off).

stationLight.label: Station light
stationLight.help: The faint background light everywhere. Raise it if the station is too dark to play.
